title: Quenched Pillowy Peruvian Kippers Ceviche Clasico
description: A refreshing and umami-rich Peruvian dish featuring kippers, perfect for curing hangovers, with a pillowy texture and no onions or garlic, served as a ceviche clasico in a raclette grill vessel
instructions: Preheat the raclette grill vessel to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
Caramelize the sweet plantains in a pan with a little oil until golden brown
In a large bowl, mix together the kippers, lemon juice, coriander, aji amarillo peppers, sweet potatoes, corn kernels, evaporated milk, salt, and black pepper
Stir well to combine and let it marinate in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes
Just before serving, stir in the caramelized sweet plantains
Spoon the ceviche into the preheated raclette grill vessel
Serve immediately and garnish with additional coriander and chopped aji amarillo peppers if desired
Provide tortilla chips or tostadas on the side for a crunchy accompaniment
